1.english_reference: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְח֞וּ כָּל עַ֤ם יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἔλαβεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τῆς γῆς τὸν Ὀχοζείαν ,
traditions.VUL: Omnis autem pópulus Iuda fílium eius Ozíam ,
traditions.KJV: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah ,

traditions.WLC: וְ ה֕וּא בֶּן שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐτὸς δέκα καὶ ἓξ ἐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: annórum sédecim ,
traditions.KJV: who [ was ] sixteen years old ,

1.english_reference: and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּמְלִ֣יכוּ אֹת֔ וֹ תַּ֖חַת אָבִ֥י ו אֲמַצְיָֽהוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐβασίλευσαν αὐτὸν ἀντὶ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἀμασείου .
traditions.VUL: constítuit regem pro Amasía patre suo .
traditions.KJV: and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah .

traditions.WLC: ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת אֵיל֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: αὐτὸς ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Αἰλάθ ,
traditions.VUL: Ipse ædificávit Ailath ,
traditions.KJV: He built Eloth ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְשִׁיבֶ֖ הָ לִֽ יהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: αὐτὸς ἐπέστρεψεν αὐτὴν τῷ Ἰούδᾳ
traditions.VUL: et restítuit eam ditióni Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: and restored it to Judah ,

2.english_reference: after that the king slept with his fathers

traditions.WLC: אַחֲרֵ֥י שְׁכַֽב הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם אֲבֹתָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: μετὰ τὸ κοιμηθῆναι τὸν βασιλέα μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: postquam dormívit rex cum pátribus suis .
traditions.KJV: after that the king slept with his fathers .

3.english_reference: Sixteen years old [ was ] Uzziah when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן שֵׁ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ בְ מָלְכ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Υἱὸς δέκα ἓξ ἐτῶν Ὀζείας ,
traditions.VUL: Sédecim annórum erat Ozías cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: Sixteen years old [ was ] Uzziah when he began to reign ,

3.english_reference: and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּ שְׁתַּ֨יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πεντήκοντα καὶ δύο ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: et quinquagínta duóbus annis regnávit in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem .

3.english_reference: His mother ’s name also [ was ] Jecoliah of Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ יכיליה מִן יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Χααιὰ ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: nomen matris eius Iechelía de Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: His mother ’s name also [ was ] Jecoliah of Jerusalem .

4.english_reference: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: Fecítque quod erat rectum in óculis Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD ,

4.english_reference: according to all that his father Amaziah did

traditions.WLC: כְּ כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ אָבִֽי ו
traditions.LXX: κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν Ἀμασείας ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: iuxta ómnia quæ fécerat Amasías pater eius .
traditions.KJV: according to all that his father Amaziah did .

5.english_reference: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִי֙ לִ דְרֹ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בִּ ימֵ֣י זְכַרְיָ֔הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν ἐκζητῶν τὸν κύριον ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις Ζαχαρίου
traditions.VUL: Et exquisívit Dóminum in diébus Zacharíæ
traditions.KJV: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah ,

5.english_reference: who had understanding in the visions of God

traditions.WLC: הַ מֵּבִ֖ין בִּ רְאֹ֣ת הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: τοῦ συνιόντος ἐν φόβῳ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: intelligéntis et vidéntis Deum :
traditions.KJV: who had understanding in the visions of God :

5.english_reference: and as long as he sought the LORD , God made him to prosper

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ ימֵי֙ דָּרְשׁ֣ וֹ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה הִצְלִיח֖ וֹ הָ אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ ἐζήτησεν τὸν κύριον , καὶ εὐόδωσεν αὐτῷ Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: cumque requíreret Dóminum , diréxit eum in ómnibus .
traditions.KJV: and as long as he sought the LORD , God made him to prosper .

6.english_reference: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵא֙ וַ יִּלָּ֣חֶם בַּ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἐπολέμησεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους ,
traditions.VUL: Dénique egréssus est , et pugnávit contra Philísthiim ,
traditions.KJV: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines ,

6.english_reference: and brake down the wall of Gath , and the wall of Jabneh , and the wall of Ashdod

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּפְרֹ֞ץ אֶת ח֣וֹמַת גַּ֗ת וְ אֵת֙ חוֹמַ֣ת יַבְנֵ֔ה וְ אֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת אַשְׁדּ֑וֹד
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέσπασεν τὰ τείχη Γὲθ καὶ τὰ τείχη Ἀβεννὴρ καὶ τὰ τείχη Ἀζώτου ,
traditions.VUL: et destrúxit murum Geth , et murum Iábniæ , murúmque Azóti :
traditions.KJV: and brake down the wall of Gath , and the wall of Jabneh , and the wall of Ashdod ,

6.english_reference: and built cities about Ashdod , and among the Philistines

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּבְנֶ֣ה עָרִ֔ים בְּ אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וּ בַ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν πόλεις Ἀζώτου καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀλλοφύλοις .
traditions.VUL: ædificávit quoque óppida in Azóto et in Philísthiim .
traditions.KJV: and built cities about Ashdod , and among the Philistines .

7.english_reference: And God helped him against the Philistines

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעְזְרֵ֨ הוּ הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֜ים עַל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֧ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατίσχυσεν αὐτὸν Κύριος ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους
traditions.VUL: Et adiúvit eum Deus contra Philísthiim ,
traditions.KJV: And God helped him against the Philistines ,

7.english_reference: and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gurbaal

traditions.WLC: וְ עַל ה ערביים הַ יֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בְּ גוּר בָּ֖עַל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς Ἄραβας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς πέτρας
traditions.VUL: et contra Arabes , qui habitábant in Gúrbaal ,
traditions.KJV: and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gurbaal ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ מְּעוּנִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς Μειναίους .
traditions.VUL: et contra Ammonítas .
traditions.KJV: and the Mehunims .

8.english_reference: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְּנ֧וּ הָֽ עַמּוֹנִ֛ים מִנְחָ֖ה לְ עֻזִּיָּ֑הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ Μειναῖοι δῶρα τῷ Ὀζείᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: Appendebántque Ammonítæ múnera Ozíæ :
traditions.KJV: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah :

8.english_reference: and his name spread abroad [ even ] to the entering in of Egypt

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁמ וֹ֙ עַד לְ ב֣וֹא מִצְרַ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἕως εἰσόδου Αἰγύπτου ,
traditions.VUL: et divulgátum est nomen eius usque ad intróitum Ægýpti
traditions.KJV: and his name spread abroad [ even ] to the entering in of Egypt ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י הֶחֱזִ֖יק עַד לְ מָֽעְלָ ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι κατίσχυσεν ἕως ἄνω .
traditions.VUL: propter crebras victórias .
traditions.KJV: for he strengthened [ himself ] exceedingly .

9.english_reference: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֨בֶן עֻזִּיָּ֤הוּ מִגְדָּלִים֙ בִּ יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν Ὀζείας πύργους ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: Ædificavítque Ozías turres in Ierúsalem
traditions.KJV: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: עַל שַׁ֧עַר הַ פִּנָּ֛ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν πύλην τῆς γωνίας
traditions.VUL: super portam ánguli ,
traditions.KJV: at the corner gate ,

traditions.WLC: וְ עַל שַׁ֥עַר הַ גַּ֖יְא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν πύλην γωνίας τῆς φάραγγος
traditions.VUL: et super portam vallis ,
traditions.KJV: and at the valley gate ,

9.english_reference: and at the turning [ of the wall ]

traditions.WLC: וְ עַל הַ מִּקְצ֑וֹעַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν γωνιῶν
traditions.VUL: et réliquas in eódem muri látere ,
traditions.KJV: and at the turning [ of the wall ] ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְחַזְּקֵֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατίσχυσεν .
traditions.VUL: firmavítque eas .
traditions.KJV: and fortified them .

10.english_reference: Also he built towers in the desert

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֨בֶן מִגְדָּלִ֜ים בַּ מִּדְבָּ֗ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν πύργους ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Exstrúxit étiam turres in solitúdine ,
traditions.KJV: Also he built towers in the desert ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּחְצֹב֙ בֹּר֣וֹת רַבִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐλατόμησεν λάκκους πολλούς ,
traditions.VUL: et effódit cistérnas plúrimas ,
traditions.KJV: and digged many wells :

10.english_reference: for he had much cattle , both in the low country , and in the plains

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י מִקְנֶה רַּב֙ הָ֣יָה ל֔ וֹ וּ בַ שְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וּ בַ מִּישׁ֑וֹר
traditions.LXX: ὅτι κτήνη πολλὰ ὑπῆρχεν αὐτῷ ἐν Σεφηλὰ καὶ ἐν τῇ πεδινῇ
traditions.VUL: eo quod habéret multa pécora , tam in campéstribus , quam in erémi vastitáte :
traditions.KJV: for he had much cattle , both in the low country , and in the plains :

10.english_reference: husbandmen [ also ] , and vine dressers in the mountains , and in Carmel

traditions.WLC: אִכָּרִ֣ים וְ כֹֽרְמִ֗ים בֶּ הָרִים֙ וּ בַ כַּרְמֶ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀμπελουργοὶ ἐν τῇ ὀρεινῇ καὶ ἐν τῷ Καρμήλῳ ,
traditions.VUL: víneas quoque hábuit et vinitóres in móntibus , et in Carmélo :
traditions.KJV: husbandmen [ also ] , and vine dressers in the mountains , and in Carmel :

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אֹהֵ֥ב אֲדָמָ֖ה הָיָֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι γεωργὸς ἦν .
traditions.VUL: erat quippe homo agricultúræ déditus .
traditions.KJV: for he loved husbandry .

11.english_reference: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֣י לְ עֻזִּיָּ֡הוּ חַיִל֩ עֹשֵׂ֨ה מִלְחָמָ֜ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο Ὀζείᾳ δυνάμεις ποιοῦσαι πόλεμον
traditions.VUL: Fuit autem exércitus bellatórum eius ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men ,

11.english_reference: that went out to war by bands

traditions.WLC: יוֹצְאֵ֧י צָבָ֣א לִ גְד֗וּד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκπορευόμεναι εἰς παράταξιν
traditions.VUL: qui procedébant ad prœ́lia
traditions.KJV: that went out to war by bands ,

11.english_reference: according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler

traditions.WLC: בְּ מִסְפַּר֙ פְּקֻדָּתָ֔ ם בְּ יַד֙ יעואל הַ סּוֹפֵ֔ר וּ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֖הוּ הַ שּׁוֹטֵ֑ר
traditions.LXX: εἰς ἀριθμόν · καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν διὰ χειρὸς Ἰειὴλ τοῦ γραμματέως καὶ Ἀμασαίου τοῦ κριτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: sub manu Iéhiel scribæ , Maasiǽque doctóris ,
traditions.KJV: according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler ,

11.english_reference: under the hand of Hananiah , [ one ] of the king ’s captains

traditions.WLC: עַ֚ל יַד חֲנַנְיָ֔הוּ מִ שָּׂרֵ֖י הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: διὰ χειρὸς Ἁνανίου τοῦ διαδόχου τοῦ βασιλέως .
traditions.VUL: et sub manu Hananíæ , qui erat de dúcibus regis .
traditions.KJV: under the hand of Hananiah , [ one ] of the king ’s captains .

12.english_reference: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour [ were ] two thousand and six hundred

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֠ל מִסְפַּ֞ר רָאשֵׁ֤י הָ אָבוֹת֙ לְ גִבּ֣וֹרֵי חָ֔יִל אַלְפַּ֖יִם וְ שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: πᾶς ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν πατριαρχῶν τῶν δυνατῶν εἰς πόλεμον δισχίλιοι ἑξακόσιοι ,
traditions.VUL: Omnísque númerus príncipum per famílias , virórum fórtium duórum míllium sexcentórum .
traditions.KJV: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour [ were ] two thousand and six hundred .

13.english_reference: And under their hand [ was ] an army

traditions.WLC: וְ עַל יָדָ ם֩ חֵ֨יל צָבָ֜א
traditions.LXX: καὶ μετ᾽ αὐτῶν δύναμις πολεμικὴ
traditions.VUL: Et sub eis univérsus exércitus
traditions.KJV: And under their hand [ was ] an army ,

13.english_reference: three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred

traditions.WLC: שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֗לֶף וְ שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וַ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: τριακόσιαι χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακισχίλιοι πεντακόσιοι ·
traditions.VUL: trecentórum et septem míllium quingentórum ,
traditions.KJV: three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred ,

13.english_reference: that made war with mighty power , to help the king against the enemy

traditions.WLC: עוֹשֵׂ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּ כֹ֣חַ חָ֑יִל לַ עְזֹ֥ר לַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל הָ אוֹיֵֽב
traditions.LXX: οὗτοι οἱ ποιοῦντες πόλεμον ἐν δυνάμει ἰσχύος βοηθῆσαι τῷ βασιλεῖ ἐπὶ τοὺς ὑπεναντίους .
traditions.VUL: qui erant apti ad bella , et pro rege contra adversários dimicábant .
traditions.KJV: that made war with mighty power , to help the king against the enemy .

14.english_reference: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּכֶן֩ לָ הֶ֨ם עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ לְ כָל הַ צָּבָ֗א
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡτοίμασεν αὐτοὺς Ὀζείας πάσῃ τῇ δυνάμει
traditions.VUL: Præparávit quoque eis Ozías , id est , cuncto exercítui ,
traditions.KJV: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host

14.english_reference: shields , and spears , and helmets , and habergeons , and bows , and slings

traditions.WLC: מָגִנִּ֤ים וּ רְמָחִים֙ וְ כ֣וֹבָעִ֔ים וְ שִׁרְיֹנ֖וֹת וּ קְשָׁת֑וֹת וּ לְ אַבְנֵ֖י קְלָעִֽים
traditions.LXX: θυρεοὺς καὶ δόρατα καὶ περικεφαλαίας καὶ θώρακας καὶ τόξα καὶ σφενδόνας
traditions.VUL: clýpeos , et hastas , et gáleas , et lorícas , arcúsque et fundas
traditions.KJV: shields , and spears , and helmets , and habergeons , and bows , and slings [ to cast ]

traditions.LXX: εἰς λίθους .
traditions.VUL: ad iaciéndos lápides .
traditions.KJV: stones .

15.english_reference: And he made in Jerusalem engines , invented by cunning men

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֣עַשׂ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם חִשְּׁבֹנ֜וֹת מַחֲשֶׁ֣בֶת חוֹשֵׁ֗ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ μηχανὰς μεμηχανευμένας λογιστοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Et fecit in Ierúsalem divérsi géneris máchinas ,
traditions.KJV: And he made in Jerusalem engines , invented by cunning men ,
